biggest_catch: Credits take up to 90 days and are strictly contingent on the referred customer staying active for 60 consecutive days and making at least one on-time paid-in-full payment — if they cancel or are disconnected before day 60, NEITHER side gets anything.
catches: Referred customer must remain an active Chariot Energy customer for at least 60 consecutive days from the service start date AND complete at least one on-time, paid-in-full bill payment; otherwise neither side earns.
Referrer credit ($100) and referral credit ($50) are paid within 90 days of the qualification being met, not at signup.
Only active Chariot Energy customers qualify; the referral code field must be valid and the referral code/promocode REF1 used at enrollment.
The refer-a-friend bill credit is NOT valid with any other offers or promotions; referral incentives only apply to new enrollments submitted July 15, 2026 – December 31, 2026.
Bill credits cannot be exchanged for cash; if service is discontinued, no payout on negative balances from referral credits.
Program can be changed or terminated at Chariot's sole discretion without notice; Chariot may cap accumulated referral credit.
Framing: credits reduce future Chariot bills; you must already be (or become) a Chariot customer to earn the referrer side.
